title: ResumePatch
description: The structured output schema Gemini must conform to when generating resume patches. Used as the response_schema in the google-genai SDK call. The Pydantic model in gemini_client.py mirrors this schema exactly.

track.description: Which resume track this patch targets, or 'irrelevant' if the role is out of scope.

patches.description: List of surgical bullet-point replacements. Max 5 patches per resume.

section.description: Which resume section contains the bullet to patch.

job_id.description: The identifier of the job or project entry in the base resume (e.g., 'job_1', 'proj_2'). Must match an existing id in the base resume.

bullet_index.description: Zero-based index of the bullet point within the job/project entry to replace.

new_text.description: The replacement bullet text. Must start with a strong action verb. Must be a single sentence. Must not fabricate metrics or dates not present in the original bullet.

original_text.description: The original bullet text being replaced. Included for audit logging.

skills_addendum.description: Additional skills/tools from the JD to append to the Skills section. Max 6 items. Must be technologies/tools mentioned in the JD that the candidate plausibly has experience with.

confidence_score.description: Gemini's confidence that this role is a good fit for the candidate (0.0 = poor fit, 1.0 = excellent fit). Used for Discord embed display and filtering.

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of patch decisions and confidence score. For audit logging only; not rendered in the PDF.

jd_keywords_matched.description: Key technical terms from the JD that influenced the patch. For audit logging.
